notes.title: PATCH 1.0.2 is here!
notes.content:
[h2][h1]1.0.2 Patch Notes[/h1][/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Procedural challenge layouts[/b] no longer repeat the same object placement each time.
[*] [b]Steam Deck resolution list[/b] now excludes unintended low-resolution options when using Borderless mode.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]“The Architect’s Knowledge” achievement[/b] can now be completed. It no longer requires the golden gem that was previously locked behind the achievement itself.
[*] [b]The “Soda Star” item[/b] no longer reduces its own critical bonus damage due to a hidden modifier.
[*] [b]Bol-Love-Aro achievement[/b] now properly tracks item purchases made during challenges.
[*] [b]Restored the missing text[/b] in Bernardo’s dialogue after losing to the Doppelganger.
[*] Various [b]localization[/b] fixes
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1 is here!
notes.content:
[h1]1.0.1 Patch Notes[/h1]


[h2]Improvements[/h2]

- Reduced enemies' health in Biomes 2 & 3.
- Combo now lasts 2.5s and fades for 1s
- Effects for the following items have been adjusted:
[list]
[*] [b]Real Estate Expert[/b] → Entering a hostile room generates [strike]5/10/20/35[/strike] [b]10/20/30/50[/b] shards
[*] [b]Certified pyrotechnician[/b] → Hitting an enemy with a bomb generates [strike]1/2/3/5[/strike] [b]3/5/7/10[/b] explosive shards
[*] [b]Auric Obsession[/b] → Grant [strike]1[/strike] 1/2/3/5 gold every [strike]30/25/20/10[/strike] [b]20[/b] combo points
[*] [b]Drinkable Gunpowder[/b] → Weapon becomes a bomb every [strike]35/30/25/15[/strike] [b]30/25/20/10[/b] combo points
[*] [b]Static Electricity[/b] → Remain at [strike]40/35/25/10[/strike] [b]20/15/10/5[/b] combo points, weapon attacks generate electric arcs
[*] [b]Weaponsmith Expert[/b] → As long as you remain at 10+ combo points, generate [strike]2[/strike] 5 shards every [strike]1s[/strike] [b]3/2.5/2/1s[/b]
[*] [b]Shattered heart[/b] → Weapon generates shard every [strike]0.25s[/strike] [b]0.2s[/b]
[/list]
- Echo dice effects now trigger directly when interacting with “heart” items such as Infernal Heart.
- New icons added for the patterns to make them easier to understand.
- Various improvements and fixes for some of the Experiences.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

- Patterns can no longer be farmed indefinitely.
- [b]Bomb Room[/b] description no longer claims to grant control.
- Doors in the 2nd Biome no longer unexpectedly lock players behind them.
- Fixed issue where the Doppelganger unlock sequence dialog triggered too early.
- Removed lag caused by Echo Device + Electricity
- Potion "Hazardous Duplicator" no longer grants common versions of items that were unintended.
- Boss achievements unlock correctly if defeated without taking any hits.
- Fixed issue preventing the [b]Bo-Love-Aro[/b] achievement from unlocking correctly.
- Addressed problem where the quality control item appeared incorrectly in Act 1.
- Fixed card VFX not displaying properly during ACT unlocking sequences.
- [b]Rotten Egg[/b] gives the correct amount of empty hearts for each curse.
- Bernardo's Codex entry has been restored in English.
- Codex entries are no longer cut off in Spanish.
- Character names are correctly translated in certain languages.
- Various localization fixes in all languages.

notes.title: How did we approach replayability ?
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

Hey everyone, I’m Jérémy, Game Director for Cryptical Path. I'm excited to walk you through our approach to replayability in the game, which happens to be the focus point of this week's fest.
Of course, Cryptical Path is an action rogue-lite, and this means a lot in terms of replay value. That's why I'm going to dive into some aspects of the game that influenced us during the design process and that I think had an impact on this particular subject. We've always aimed for the game to be highly replayable, as it is a characteristic of rogue games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44678730/4537a336d2957dd3059f63f9980dd4536116b089.png[/img]

[h2]Unique combinations of items in every Run:[/h2]
When crafting the game's items, our primary focus was ensuring that each playthrough offered a unique experience for the player. This involved creating items capable of altering gameplay dynamics and fostering synergies between seemingly basic components. While not every item is intended to be a game-changer on its own, the combination of several can yield unexpected results.
For instance, consider the combination of an item that reduces spell cooldowns with another that enables spells to generate echo dice. This synergy completely transforms gameplay dynamics, allowing players to utilize their dice from a considerable distance using spells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44678730/d3dcf9b8eed9ba4169a7a3121fa7448e151f4f1d.gif[/img]

[h2]The Hexium Map:[/h2]
This main feature adds a layer of complexity to the game, and offers choices in the gameplay. It's truly something that can enhance replayability as each run can be different based on how you use it.
We believe the Hexium map is more than just a tool, it's a versatile feature designed to empower players to tailor their gameplay experience to their preferences. This innovative approach not only helps players in adapting to the unpredictability of random generation but also serves as a means to dynamically alter the challenges they encounter in each run.

This feature is truly what sets our game apart, offering players the ability to strategically place rooms and regain control over their experience, mitigating the potential drawbacks of randomness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44678730/cc4407497df1a002bfd19d607cfd5e9d6ef9b6e2.gif[/img]

[h2]Challenges and Difficulty Modes:[/h2]
Replaying a level is only enjoyable when it's inherently fun to play. We firmly believe that players should find genuine enjoyment in the core gameplay experience before considering replayability. However, merely offering different items, rooms and enemies each run isn't sufficient. Introducing varied objectives also motivates players to retry and replay until they achieve success, thereby providing them with a gratifying sense of accomplishment. This principle lies at the heart of rogue games, often rendering them challenging to complete.

In Cryptical Path, we've designed different modes that go beyond simple difficulty levels like easy, medium, or hard. Instead, these modes progressively escalate the complexity of the game, offering players a deeper and more nuanced experience rather than just balanced difficulty levels.

[h2]Engaging Progression:[/h2]
As our game is a roguelite, we've incorporated progression systems to assist players along their journey. By implementing these systems, we can introduce more complex features gradually, ensuring a smoother onboarding process and avoiding overwhelming players right from the start. These systems take the form of a talent tree, achievement system, and unlockable items.

While these features may not directly enhance replayability, they serve as compelling reasons for players to start the game. Unlocking cool new items and experimenting with different playstyles adds depth and variety to each playthrough, encouraging players to approach the game in unique ways every time while having something to achieve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44678730/6618fddeec0886c4a736a55df45244610a127ff3.gif[/img]

[h2]Balancing Run Length:[/h2]
One of the most challenging aspects of designing Cryptical Path was finding the right balance between punishment and progression. Each run needed to be sufficiently lengthy to feel unique, yet not excessively so that losing felt overly harsh. That is also why we decided to implement the progression systems that we talked before, it helps having short runs at the beginning, and make them last longer as a player progresses through the game.

That's all for now, enjoy the Endless Replayability Fest!

notes.title: Demo Update: Take the Tour
notes.content:
Hi Architects, 

As we prepare for the Steam Next Fest period, we are releasing a new demo with several improvements. These include a brand new weapon to help you navigate the dungeon, balancing fixes, and an enhanced onboarding experience for newcomers. Take a look at the complete list below:

[h3]Main Changes[/h3]
[list][*]New weapon: [b]the Dice[/b]. The Architect is now carrying a brand new weapon that replaces the old one: the dice. Roll it and meet your destiny. 10 New items comes with the dice, creating new possibilities for synergy and massive destructions.
[*]By popular demand, we added invincibility frames on dash
[*]We’ve worked on an improved onboarding experience to allow newcomers to start their journey in the dungeon more easily[/list]
[h3]Progression [/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now collect frozen souls during your run to spend in your hub
[*] You can now access the Hub and meet Bernardo
[*] You can purchase new items to find in your future runs 
[*] You can unlock new rooms to use on the board
[*] Fixes and polish to increase overhaul immersion and correct multiple issues.
[/list]
[h3]Board [/h3]
[list]
[*] Art and FX have been reworked to make board more clear & readable
[*] When the board is locked (-10 controls) path is now created leading to the boss and raising the difficulty to its maximum instead of giving the ability to teleport to the boss room.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Difficulty of visited rooms increases overtime
[*] Changed the price of rooms you can place 
[*] You start the game with 5 hearts (was 3)
[*] You start the game with 10 control (was 5)
[*] Boss has New attack patterns
[*] Boss attacks order patterns is now random
[/list]

Have a suggestion for more improvements? [url=https://discord.gg/f5rhsb3Cuj]Join the Cryptical Path Community on Discord[/url] and share your ideas in the server.
